flags.why: A common everyday use means giving someone extra money for their work or help.
flags.fix: verb | to give extra pay; to give a gratuity

flags.why: In everyday speech, mặc định also means assuming something is true or taking it for granted.
flags.fix: verb | to assume; to take for granted

flags.why: Tài tử remains a current word for a film actor or star, especially a male one.
Calling performers of đờn ca tài tử tài tử is still current in this living musical tradition.
Hoàn lương can describe reforming after crime or other disreputable activities, so it does not necessarily imply prostitution.
flags.fix: to reform and return to an honest life (after crime, prostitution, or other disreputable activities)
